findings.summary: Test-Structure has no maximum branch; out-of-range rejection is unverifiable as written.

Spec does not constrain test approach; four fresh Invoke-TestEngine runs would lengthen a 12-17 min suite. Use Start-RunnerAttempt direct with stubbed dispatch (line ~1533 pattern) or existing run artifacts.
Resume ignoring a bound -NoOutputTimeoutMin is asymmetric with other persisted settings restored unless the CLI flag is bound.
